summary: Buffer/header copy initializer: calls BufferWriteWithParams with a pointer 4 bytes into the source object a2, then copies four header fields from a2 to this (dwords at 0x10 and 0x14, bytes at 0x18 and 0x19). Returns this.

operations.description: Call BufferWriteWithParams with source pointer at a2+4 to write buffer data before the field copy.
Copy dword field this+0x10 from a2+0x10.
Copy dword field this+0x14 from a2+0x14.
Copy byte field this+0x18 from a2+0x18.
Copy byte field this+0x19 from a2+0x19.
